title: Restricted existing finance brief source-binding scaffold

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Source export has finance metadata only; exact current task body, clock/timezone, sources and destination are unverified requirements.
No finance task may run from this scaffold until current private source scope and authorized destination are actually read under correct identity.
Use only verified source figures and as-of dates; distinguish unavailable data from zero balances or no activity.
Do not copy financial history, profiles or account identifiers into core or another provider.

success_checks: Summary uses only resolved current source evidence, explicitly marks missing coverage and stays in restricted existing destination.
No balance, source, recommendation, delivery or successful scheduled execution is fabricated from metadata.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
